limitations.quote: The fix advances each pointer on the same edge as its RAM operation.
limitations.note: The agent corrected the RAM read-enable polarity but also removed a stage of Gray-pointer latency, changing when `wfull` and `rempty` transition compared with the correct fix.
The scoreboard used the DUT's own flags to decide which transfers to expect, so it could check ordering and capacity without checking whether the flags transitioned on the required cycles.
Two attempts to launch the test had to be redone for reasons unrelated to the RTL: the first used a rejected cleanup command, and the second invoked an unavailable interpreter.
